summary: Mike Padlipsky offers two solutions to the problem, raised in RFC 487, of sending a file to someone without knowing their password. One adds a convention so the recipient pulls the file, the other adds a command. They avoid the objections to a daemon approach raised in RFC 501.

eli5.summary: How do you give someone a package if you do not know their key? Either they come and pick it up, or the sender uses a special delivery method.
